title: Runtime run
responsibility: Presents one side of recorded behavior by scenario, state and artifact.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.shown
inputs.description: The entity behavior to show: only `groups` (one section per scenario and state, with each result's outcome and artifact) and `scenarios` (each scenario's title, or its id when no entry matches) are read. The run passes only when `groups` is not empty and every group's outcome on the chosen side is `passed`.

scenarios.title: Compiled runtime evidence viewer over explicit synthetic history fixtures

examples.label: Behavior changed
reasons: behavior-interaction: the recorded output is new

scenarios.title: Compiled runtime evidence viewer over explicit synthetic history fixtures

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.side
inputs.description: Which side of each group and result this run shows: `before` or `after`, read as `group[side]` and `line[side]`. Only `after` lists each result's `differences` (as `differs at …`), and the component documents that a branch tip has only the after side.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.title
inputs.description: The pane's heading: shown in bold in the header and used as the group's accessible name (`aria-label`). It is rendered exactly as given, with no check of its text.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.role
inputs.description: The badge text for this side, shown as a chip beside the title in the header. It is rendered exactly as given, with no check of its text.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.lost
inputs.description: True when the results could not be read: each result artifact then reports that instead of being awaited. The flag is passed unchanged to every result's artifact, and the header and outcomes do not depend on it.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.refusals
inputs.description: Maps a capture's SHA-256 to its refusal message. Each result looks up `capture.sha256` of its own cell here, or the empty-string key when the cell has no capture, and passes the message it finds (undefined when there is none) to its artifact.

examples.0d4e8a2c6f1b9375e0a4d8c2f6b1e9378a5d0c4f: The bytes that were read do not have the recorded SHA-256.

examples.5e20b7a9c3d1f8e46b2a0c9d7e5f31a8b4c6d2e0: Recorded bytes cannot be read on this connection.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.unit
inputs.description: The identifier of the function the results are shown for, when they are shown as its rows; it is passed unchanged to every result's artifact. It is optional: when it is omitted, the artifact receives undefined.

outputs.name: RuntimeRun
outputs.description: The run pane as markup: a group headed by the title, the role chip and a passed or failed icon, then one section per group with its outcome icon and `scenario title · state`, and in each section one row per result with its kind chip, a Passed, Failed or Not recorded label, the differences (after side only) and its artifact. The header icon is failed whenever `groups` is empty, because a run with no group never passes.
